title: &aThe Bestiary of Ruin
subtitle: Every great monster in the pack, from first blood to the extreme.

quests.title: The Bestiary of Ruin
quests.subtitle: How to read this ladder
desc: The corruption breeds monsters. This ladder runs left to right: &fI&r early, &aII&r mid, &9III&r late, &5IV&r extreme. Each row is one mod's line of bosses.
&eCo-op:&r boss kills count for everyone in your team; chests use Lootr, so each player gets their own loot. If you die, your corpse waits for you, and a friend can carry it out.

quests.title: I. The Grunt Captain
quests.subtitle: Kings & Monsters
desc: &eOgre outposts&r dot the plains and swamps. The &eGrunt Captain&r leads each warband: big, slow, and it hits like a falling tree.
If you find the Kings & Monsters Compendium, read it: it's a field guide to ogre country.

quests.title: II. The Ogre King
desc: In the &eOgre King's Fort&r the King sits on his throne with his guard, mages and brutes. Break the guard first, then the King.
He is the Hoardwarden's trial. His crown and club are worth the trip.

quests.title: II. The Night Lich
quests.subtitle: Bosses of Mass Destruction
desc: A tower in the snow hides the &eNight Lich&r. It hurls volleys of blue fire and calls down comets. Keep moving and use cover.
The Frostbinder's trial.

quests.title: II. The Nether Gauntlet
desc: In the Nether, a giant stone fist sleeps in its arena. The &eGauntlet&r punches, fires lasers and blasts the ground. Hit its glowing eye when it opens.
The Bloodfire Berserker's trial. Its cousin the &eVoid Blossom&r grows in lush caves below the Overworld.

quests.title: III. The Obsidilith
desc: In the End stands a pillar of living obsidian. The &eObsidilith&r sends out shockwaves, raises spikes from the floor and drops anvils.
Keep moving, and don't fight it near the edge of an island.

quests.title: I. The Mother Spider
quests.subtitle: Born in Chaos
desc: &eBorn in Chaos&r fills the night with horrors: decaying zombies, bone imps, dread hounds, pumpkin-headed riders. Blood Moons bring more of them.
The swollen &eMother Spider&r never hunts alone: her spiderlings swarm you. Kill the brood fast.

quests.title: III. Lord Pumpkinhead
desc: The headless lord rides a hellish steed and throws burning pumpkin bombs. Knock him from the saddle and he fights on foot, angrier.
Born in Chaos's darkest knight.

quests.title: I. The Archevoker
quests.subtitle: Iron's Spells
desc: At the head of an &eevoker fort&r stands the &eArchevoker&r, an illager mage with fangs, vexes and shields of its own.
Its robes are Archevoker school armour: Lightwardens take note.

quests.title: III. The Dead King
desc: Follow a &eWayward Compass&r to the Catacombs. The &eDead King&r rises from his throne with a blade of the grave and the spells of a dead age.
The Lightwarden's trial. He can be raised again: use a Dead King Phylactery on his soul.

quests.title: IV. The Echo of Tyros
desc: In Iron's &eCitadel&r, where the Ancient Knights still stand guard, burns the &eEcho of Tyros, First Flamebearer&r: a fire mage boss of the extreme tier.
Fire resistance, ice spells, and a full party.

quests.title: II. The Corrupted Champion
quests.subtitle: The Graveyard
desc: &eThe Graveyard&r spreads graveyards, crypts and haunted houses, and ghouls, revenants and wraiths with them. In a &eLich Prison&r, an altar can call up the &eCorrupted Champion&r.
The Voidblade's trial. Bring a full party and something holy.

quests.title: II. The Harbinger
quests.subtitle: L_Ender's Cataclysm
desc: &eCataclysm&r's bosses live in huge dungeons. In the &eAncient Factory&r, the &eHarbinger&r, a wither-machine of missiles and lasers, waits to be switched on.
The Stormwright's trial. Strafe its lasers and shoot down its missiles.

quests.title: III. The Netherite Monstrosity
desc: In the Nether's &eSoul Black Smith&r forge sleeps the &eNetherite Monstrosity&r, a living siege engine that sprays lava and shakes the ground.
Fire resistance is not optional.

quests.title: III. Ignis
desc: In the &eBurning Arena&r, the flame knight &eIgnis&r fights in three phases, each hotter than the last. In the end his sword and shield fall to the worthy.
His Ignitium makes some of the best armour in the game.

quests.title: III. The Ancient Remnant
desc: Under the desert, the &eCursed Pyramid&r hides the &eAncient Remnant&r, a colossal sand-beast that charges through walls.
Cataclysm has more to hunt at this tier: the Ender Guardian in the Ruined Citadel, Maledictus in the Frosted Prison, Scylla in the Acropolis.

quests.title: III. The Leviathan
desc: The &eSunken City&r lies at the bottom of the sea, and the &eLeviathan&r rules it. Fight underwater: Water Breathing, Respiration, and a Tide Guardian or Conduit if you have one.
Lantern rings keep you breathing while lit.

quests.title: I. The Frostbitten Golem
quests.subtitle: Legendary Monsters
desc: &eLegendary Monsters&r hides a boss in each of its temples and ruins. In the &eFrostbitten Temple&r, an icy golem guards the treasure.
Its eyes (Eye of Frost, Eye of Moss...) belong to these bosses; look them up in JEI.

quests.title: II. The Overgrown Colossus
desc: Moss and stone walk in the &eMossy Temple&r: the &eOvergrown Colossus&r. It's slow and it hits very hard.
Other Legendary bosses wait in the Cloudy Temple, the Ruined Pyramid, the Shulker Tower and the Skeletosaurus Nest.

quests.title: IV. The Obliterator
desc: On a &eSpace Station&r in the End waits &eThe Obliterator&r. No hit on it does more than 20 damage, it adapts to your attacks, and it heals if you leave it alone.
It can't be hurt while you fly or hold high ground: fight it on its own level, rings off.
